items.html: And through his clothing in these two Yesods, which are the male and female of Aba and Ima, Arich then coupled with himself, Yesod in Atara, in the secret of the lower coupling. And the Yesod gave to the Atara those drops that were drawn to it from the aspect of the upper coupling of Hochma and the throat mentioned above, and brought forth ZON in the aspect of three included in three.
